result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a faded crosswalk. The environment is primarily residential or mixed-use with some visual obstructions from parked vehicles and poor pavement quality in the roadway.

hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and patched, creating potential trip hazards and uneven surfaces for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate trip hazards and improve the overall walking environment.

result.summary: A narrow urban residential street with sidewalks on both sides and mature street trees providing shade. The environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings, traffic control devices, or lane markings, relying on the narrow geometry to manage speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements across the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb create sightline barriers between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement surface
hazards.description: Visible patching and cracking in the asphalt can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with a sidewalk and a large tree. A gated parking area creates a potential vehicle-pedestrian conflict point, and the sidewalk pavement is cracked near the tree pit.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and buckled sidewalk near the tree pit creates a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, around the base of the tree.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: The gated entrance to a parking area creates a point where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, the black gate and driveway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair the cracked sidewalk panels and install a tree grate or flexible paving to accommodate root growth.

interventions.title: Driveway Warning
interventions.description: Ensure clear sightlines at the driveway and consider adding tactile or visual warnings for exiting vehicles.
